subject.title: Complementary tool: automated skill quality scoring for curation workflow

question: Should ClawHub formally endorse or integrate this third-party model-backed quality and eval tool, and if so must its outputs remain advisory and separate from security and moderation decisions?
rationale: Current code cannot determine evaluator authority, third-party dependency ownership, model data handling, score semantics, or how an official-looking result should affect curation; those require maintainer intent.

options.title: Define advisory integration
options.body: Create a provider-neutral advisory result contract with provenance and data-handling rules, then assess this CLI as one optional producer with no direct enforcement authority.

options.title: Document reviewer tooling
options.body: Mention the CLI only as optional external reviewer tooling and do not store or display its scores as official ClawHub signals.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Decline formal endorsement until the broader quality-signal discussion establishes demand, semantics, and ownership.

recommendation.title: Define advisory integration
recommendation.body: Create a provider-neutral advisory result contract with provenance and data-handling rules, then assess this CLI as one optional producer with no direct enforcement authority.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current quality, scan, and inspector surfaces most directly affected by this product-boundary choice.
